verses: Then I saw the soul of a certain woman whose tongue was plucked out Doubtful; it may mean 'whose tongues were many.'.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this woman?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman whose tongue, in the world, was sharp; and her husband and master was much troubled by her tongue.'
